title.en: Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 5, Official Voter Information Guide
Attorney General's title and summary of Proposition 5, with the Analyst's fiscal estimate, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The Analyst confirms that Proposition 5 removes the second question, who should replace a recalled official, from the recall ballot. It also makes the office vacant and specifies how vacancies are filled, including a separate process for the Governor, where the Lieutenant Governor serves.

description.en: Official Voter Information Guide, argument in favor of Proposition 5

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election: arguments and rebuttals on Proposition 5

speaker.en: Official argument in favor of Proposition 5

text: Proposition 5 makes a single, commonsense change: it removes the second question from the recall ballot.
